  <h2>Resources</h2>
  <div class="site-lede site-muted">
    <p>
      This section brings together materials that sit alongside my research and teaching: explanations of key concepts, longer-form writing, and interactive demonstrations. They are intended as different ways into the same set of questions about complexity, cybernetics, emergence, information, and collective behaviour.
    </p>
    <p>
      Some resources provide orientation before encountering a technical idea; others invite experimentation or develop a line of thought beyond the format of a research paper. You can browse them independently or move between them as related concepts appear across the site.
    </p>
